entries.message: Chore - Reset develop build counter after promotion to alpha
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: promoteDevelopToAlpha() now zeroes develop's build counter (not just its entry list) when develop is promoted to alpha, so the next develop push after a promotion starts back at build 1

This reset is safe because it happens as a deliberate, explicit step of the promotion itself, not an inferred comparison against a version string that could be stale - the same safe shape as alpha's own reset-on-promotion-to-main
Documented the distinction in update-develop-changelog.js and docs/architecture.md
Applies retroactively for the develop -> alpha promotion already run this session, now that the reset is part of the documented Force to alpha procedure
Next push to develop starts back at Develop Build 1
